title: The tools the room's owner serves an agent are declared in the order they were set up, whichever kind each is: work_in_background, then delegate_task, whose call waits by design, then task_status and cancel_task
notes: Python: channels/_tool_registry.py ChannelRegistry.entries and owner_entries, each in the order they were registered; turns/_executor_calls.py TurnOwnerTools built from the request's owner_tools in their order. tasks/delegate.py _served_entry sets delegate_task up as waiting by design (waits=True); core/mixins/background.py setup_background and setup_task_tools set theirs up as bounded. A bounded tool on each side of the waiting one: an order grouped by kind, whichever comes first, is not this one.
